description.content: Retrieve tracking event updates for a reference

info.name: Vizion Container Tracking References Updates API

description.content:
The Vizion Container Tracking API provides standardized shipment tracking events from ocean carriers, terminals, rail, and customs data sources. Subscribe to a container by providing its container ID and carrier SCAC code. Receive real-time updates via webhooks or poll for tracking milestones via GET endpoints. All events follow a consistent JSON schema regardless of carrier or data source.
